intro: Financial advisors can use AI to automate the tedious process of drafting client summaries by leveraging local tools to synthesize data from spreadsheets and meeting notes. This shift allows you to move away from manual data entry and focus on the strategic advice your clients actually pay for.

blocks.text: The hidden cost of manual reporting

The primary problem is that your time is split between being a financial expert and a data clerk. You likely spend your day moving numbers from an ERP or CRM into a spreadsheet, then moving those numbers again into a Word document or PDF. This is not just a waste of time. It introduces risk.

Every time you copy and paste a figure, you create a chance for a typo. When you rebuild a report from scratch because the source data changed, you lose time you could spend on client meetings. This is why many firms struggle with decision latency. By the time the report is ready, the data is already old.
Why generating client summaries is a bottleneck

The root cause is that most reporting systems are static. They do not talk to each other. You are forced to perform manual triage to make them play nice. You spend hours searching for information in fragmented documents. This is a mechanical task that provides zero value to the client.

items: Manual copy and paste workflows between systems.
Constant context switching between email, spreadsheets, and CRMs.
Lack of standardized templates for recurring client updates.
Time lost searching for specific data points in long PDF filings.

blocks.text: You do not need an expensive overhaul to improve your output. Start by standardizing your data inputs. If your data is clean, the summary is easier to write. Move your recurring reports into dynamic templates that pull data automatically. This reduces the need to rebuild them every month.
Always verify your firm's compliance policy before using any AI tool. Many firms require you to use only approved, enterprise-grade tools that keep data within the company's private environment.
blocks.title: Compliance first

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you work faster

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It sees what you see. When you are stuck in a complex spreadsheet or looking at a long research paper, hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur for a summary. It can pull out the key trends or explain a complex calculation without you having to leave your current app.
A simple weekly plan for better reports
Use this routine to reclaim your time. It focuses on batching your work so you are not context switching all day.

items: Monday Morning: Aggregate all raw data from your CRM and portfolio tools into one master sheet.
Tuesday Afternoon: Use AI to draft initial summaries based on the data you aggregated on Monday.
Wednesday Morning: Review and refine the AI drafts with your own strategic insights.
Thursday: Finalize and send reports to clients.
Friday: Spend time on high-value advisory meetings.

faq.question: Is it safe to use AI for client data?
faq.answer: You must follow your firm's specific compliance and data privacy policies. Never upload PII (Personally Identifiable Information) to public AI tools. Use local-first tools whenever possible.

faq.question: Does Lazur write the report for me?
faq.answer: Lazur can draft text based on what you see on your screen, but you are the final editor. It helps you get the first draft done faster so you can focus on the analysis.
